title: Cholera in Mexico – update
summary: The Ministry of Health in Mexico has reported an additional four cases of infection with Vibrio cholerae O1 Ogawa. Of these, three are from the state of Veracruz and one from the state of Hidalgo.

title: Wild poliovirus in Cameroon
summary: Wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) has been confirmed in Cameroon, the first wild poliovirus in the country since 2009.  Wild poliovirus was isolated from two acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) cases from West Region.

title: Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) - update
summary: WHO has been informed of an additional two laboratory-confirmed cases of infection with Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV).  These include one laboratory-confirmed case from the United Arab Emirates and one laboratory-confirmed case in Qatar.
